Card Q&A.a: No. The number of Digimon you can delete is equal to the total number of Digimon with [Hybrid] in their traits and Tamers you have in play. For example, if you have 2 Digimon with [Hybrid] in their traits and 1 Tamer in play, you can choose a total of 3 of your opponent’s Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Does “For each Digimon with [Hybrid] in its traits and each Tamer you have in play, delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon” mean that I can delete 1 of my opponent’s Digimon for each pair of [Hybrid] Digimon and Tamer I have in play?

Effect: [Main] For each Digimon with [Hybrid] in its traits and each Tamer you have in play, delete 1 of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon.
